chapter.title: Interrupts and exceptions
chapter.para: Interrupts come from the devices of the board; exceptions come from the processor when it cannot execute an instruction.

section.para: JetOS shall handle the interrupts of the timer of the board.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The timer drives the schedule, and no other device is in use.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Traceability

section.para: JetOS shall not let an interrupt other than that of the timer of the board disturb the module.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: No device other than the timer is in use, so no other interrupt may take time from the partitions.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.para: JetOS shall disable and enable the interrupts of the processor when the kernel needs to protect its data.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The kernel keeps its data consistent against interrupts this way.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Analysis.

formalpara.title: Traceability

section.para: JetOS shall tell whether the interrupts of the processor are enabled.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A kernel function restores the state of the interrupts that it found.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Analysis.

formalpara.title: Traceability

section.para: JetOS shall handle an exception of the processor in a partition as an error of the partition: a fault of the memory as a memory violation, an arithmetic one as a numeric error, and other as an illegal request or an unhandled interrupt.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The health monitoring recovers from them.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_EXCEPTIONS_ERROR_ID_FOR_01 HLR_EXCEPTIONS_JA_EXCEPTION_SYNC_USER_02 HLR_INTERRUPT_CPU_READ_CR2_01 HLR_INTERRUPT_PROCESS_EXCEPTION_01

section.para: JetOS shall report an exception in the kernel itself or an unexpected one on the console, with the registers, and stop the module.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The kernel cannot go on after an error of its own.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.para: JetOS shall acknowledge each interrupt at the interrupt controller of the board, so that the next one is delivered.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An interrupt that is not acknowledged stops the others.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.
